relatedSnapshot.title: Pre-warmed domain checkout retry can cancel paid order after Autumn subscription exists
relatedSnapshot.description:
BUG: Yes

EVIDENCE:

* Support investigation for Intercom conversation 215474831432769 found customer order `<uuid>` paid successfully in Stripe for `$84.00` at 2026-06-24 17:30 UTC, receipt `2736-7406`, charge `py_3TlubOGPuqjknq341kmSW0B1`.
* Prod DB shows the order ended `status = refunded`, `domains_provisioned = 0`, `inboxes_provisioned = 0`, with no `mail_domain` / `mail_inbox` rows for the selected domains.
* Axiom shows repeated checkout retries after payment failed with `subscription_id '<domain>' is already in use for this customer`, then reservations were released and reconcile marked the order refunded because paid balance existed but reservations were missing.
* Stripe shows `amount_refunded = 0`; cancellation left `$84` as customer credit (`customer.balance = -8400`) rather than provisioning the purchased domains/inboxes or issuing a card refund.

POTENTIAL FIX:

* In the pre-warmed domain checkout initiation/retry path, treat Autumn `subscription_id ... is already in use for this customer` as a signal that the checkout/subscription may already exist and route to payment confirmation/reconciliation instead of surfacing checkout creation failure.
* Prevent a pending/cancel action from releasing reservations when Stripe/Autumn indicates the order has already been paid or corresponding subscriptions exist.
* Add a targeted regression test around retrying `initiateDomainPurchaseCheckout` after a successful Autumn multiAttach/Stripe payment but before `confirmDomainPurchase` has marked the order paid.

WHATS NEEDED TO RESOLVE:

* Reproduce the payment retry state with mocked Autumn multiAttach returning duplicate subscription ID after an initial successful payment.
* Patch checkout confirmation/reconcile behavior so paid orders cannot be cancelled/released due to duplicate subscription IDs.
* Decide customer remediation separately: provision 2 domains + 6 inboxes using existing credit, or issue an actual Stripe refund.

relatedSnapshot.title: TRPCError: Failed query: select "assigned_at", "auto_renew", "created_at", "customer_price_cents", "domain", "expires_at", "hosting_provider", "id", "organization_id", "registrar_provider", "source", "status", "website_id" from "website_domain" "websiteDomainTable...
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

The Name 6 Domains list cannot load in any workspace where the AI Funnel Builder is not enabled: the owned-domains query applies its funnel-visibility filter to the wrong table and fails at the database, so the tab shows "Domains could not be loaded" and every domain the workspace owns is hidden. It also hides domains customers have just paid for.

## Problem

A customer opens AI Name 6 > Domains, expects to see the domains the workspace owns and assign one to a website, and instead gets "Domains could not be loaded" with a Retry button that never helps. Workspaces whose Funnel Builder entitlement is off lose the whole surface, including domains bought through the platform minutes earlier.

## Root cause

apps/web/trpc/routers/website/owned-domain-management-procedures.ts -> listOwnedDomains emits the funnel visibility filter only when isFunnelBuilderEnabledForOrganization is false, and passes it into db.query.websiteDomainTable.findMany:

not (legacyWebsiteHasActiveFunnelProjectCondition({ organizationId: websiteDomainTable.organizationId, websiteId: websiteDomainTable.websiteId }))

apps/web/lib/website/funnel-inventory.ts -> legacyWebsiteHasActiveFunnelProjectCondition returns a raw sql correlated EXISTS over website_project whose predicates reference websiteProjectTable.organizationId, websiteProjectTable.deletedAt and website_project.metadata->>'legacyWebsiteId'. Rendered inside the website_domain query those project-side references resolve against the outer websiteDomainTable, producing:

... where ("websiteDomainTable"."organization_id" = $1 and not (exists (select 1 from "website_project" where "websiteDomainTable"."organization_id" = "websiteDomainTable"."organization_id" and "websiteDomainTable"."deleted_at" is null and "websiteDomainTable"."metadata"->>'legacyWebsiteId' = ("websiteDomainTable"."website_id")::text and "websiteDomainTable"."metadata"->>'projectKind' = 'funnel')))

website_domain has neither a deleted_at nor a metadata column (confirmed against production), so the query raises "column websiteDomainTable.deleted_at does not exist" and the tRPC procedure returns INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.

Introduced by 1ca9f4b3 ("fix(ENG-13033): price self-serve Cold Email at $185 and disable self-serve funnels"), 2026-08-25. Its unit test mocks the database, so the malformed SQL was never exercised at that seam; the Sentry issue's first-seen (2026-08-25T14:50:19Z) matches that commit.

## Blast radius

Confirmed affected (Sentry ACQUISITY-4TP, procedure website.domainMarketplace.listOwnedDomains, release d7e59db005ccecf428a5f2661ef9c71de43fa8ad, measured 2026-09-11):

* 602 users / 2,776 error events since first seen 2026-08-25T14:50:19Z; 474 users / 1,980 events in the 7 days to 2026-09-11. Every event is the same failing query.
* Unresolved and ongoing.

Potentially exposed (PlanetScale production, counted 2026-09-11):

* 185 workspaces hold website_domain rows (200 rows), so they have domains that the broken list would hide; the exact split by Funnel Builder entitlement is not reachable read-only because the filter keys off a per-workspace entitlement resolved from organization.feature_flags plus partner grants.
* The malformed fragment is emitted for every workspace without the entitlement, and AI Funnel Builder is opt-in (OPT_IN_FEATURES in apps/web/lib/features.ts), so the exposed set is the large majority of workspaces rather than a small subset.
* 19 workspaces hold linked funnel projects (55 rows), the narrow case the filter was written for and the shape it breaks on.

## Proposed fix

Make the funnel-visibility filter render against the table it actually queries, or drop the correlation to website_domain columns entirely, so website.domainMarketplace.listOwnedDomains runs for workspaces without the AI Funnel Builder entitlement and returns their owned domains. The intended behaviour is unchanged: workspaces with the entitlement see their funnel-backed domains through the existing path, and workspaces without it see all their owned website domains.

## What's included

* The predicate fix in legacyWebsiteHasActiveFunnelProjectCondition and/or its call site in listOwnedDomains.
* Regression protection at the real query seam so a mocked database cannot hide this class of malformed SQL again.
* Related, not in scope: the two earlier customer reports of the same symptom whose cause was unproven (ENG-13282, ENG-13592) and this newest one (ENG-13738) all belong to this master; no separate containment or recovery work is needed because the purchase and registration paths were unaffected.

## Regression seam

Boundary: the website.domainMarketplace.listOwnedDomains tRPC query against a real database schema. Trigger: a workspace without the AI Funnel Builder entitlement that owns at least one website_domain row. Observable, red-before/green-after: before, the query throws "column websiteDomainTable.deleted_at does not exist" and the procedure returns INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; after, it returns the owned domains and the Domains tab renders them. A schema-validating test (real columns, not a mocked db) proves the causal mechanism.

## Done when

* A workspace without the AI Funnel Builder entitlement loads its Domains tab and sees every domain it owns, including platform-purchased ones.
* A workspace with the entitlement still sees exactly the funnel-backed domains the filter is meant to show, with no regression for assigned or unassigned domains.
* Sentry ACQUISITY-4TP stops receiving events on the release carrying the fix.
* A regression test at the listOwnedDomains query seam proves the malformed correlated predicate cannot render again.

## Reports

* ENG-13738 Customer report: purchased domain <domain> invisible because Name 6 Domains list fails to load
* ENG-13592 Name 6 Domains tab shows 'Domains could not be loaded' for days
* ENG-13282 Customer can't access purchased website domain — Domains tab fails to load
